title: Independence of the whole-system compositor word
statement: Fix all data A,X,Y,Z,f,g,cf,cg,ch and a uniform integral K in [def-pur-condensed-compositor-realization-data]. Given two intervening compactifications d,dprime and their common-refinement data c,r,s and cprime,rprime,sprime, the resulting actual systemCompositor components at the reduction of K are equal in the ordinary derived semilinear system category. No reduction/limit or realization is involved. The coefficient data A and its reductions are those of [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization]. Dependencies: [def-pur-condensed-compositor-realization-data], [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization].

proof.text: Dominate both tower compactifications and both final common refinements. Proper/open mate pasting, proper and open compositor associativity and identity normalization identify the two words after this domination. The pinning equations make every refinement inverse unique. Cancel the invertible common refinement components on the uniform domain. No equality detection by finite evaluation is used; finite origins supply only invertibility.
